title: Import M3U playlist
name: Playlist name
nameHint: Filled in from the file name; change it if you like.
existing: If a playlist with this name already exists
optAppend: Add the tracks to the existing playlist
optNew: Create another playlist with the same name
existingHint: Only playlists you own are considered.
advancedHint: Usually not needed: tracks are matched case-insensitively and, if the full path differs, by their folder and file name (e.g. Artist/Album/Track.mp3). Use a mapping only if tracks are reported as not found. One mapping per line, in the form m3u path prefix => Jellyfin path prefix, for example /run/media/me/music/ => /mnt/music/. file:// URLs, %20 escapes, relative paths and Windows paths are handled automatically.
nameOnly: Also match by file name alone (only if the name is unique in the library)
nameOnlyHint: Helps when tracks were moved to different folders. Turn off if you get wrong matches.
chooseFileName: Choose a file and enter a playlist name.
existsWarn:
A playlist named "{0}" already exists ({1} tracks). Nothing was changed.
Choose what to do in "{2}" and click Import again.
matched: Matched: {0} ({1} by folder/file name, {2} by file name only)
appended: Added {0} tracks to the existing playlist.
replaced: Existing playlist replaced by a new one with {0} tracks.
hintNone: file name not found in library
badEncoding: Warning: the file is not valid UTF-8, so names with accents or special characters may not match. Re-save the m3u as UTF-8 and import again.
